title: Add agent tab bar above conversation for per-agent message streams

summary.goal: Add agent tab bar above conversation for per-agent message streams.

acceptance_criteria.description: AgentTabBar renders above ConversationPane with Main tab always present
Agent tabs spawn when forge creates tasks (one tab per agent)
Messages are tagged with channel_id ('main' or 'agent-{agentId}'), tabs filter by channel
Main tab shows user messages, AI messages, system events. Agent tabs show tool calls, reasoning trace, progress.
Completed agent tabs show a completion indicator and auto-collapse after delay
Blocked agent tabs show red indicator
Clicking a system event in main tab that references an agent opens that agent's tab
Tab state persists across navigation (restored from active forge tasks on return)
ProjectMessage interface implemented with channel_id, role, content, metadata (attention_level, block_refs, step_refs, event_type)

observations: Tabs are a UI filter, not separate conversations. All messages belong to the project.
The AgentTab component adapts planner-ui's ChannelView pattern.
The key data structure is ProjectMessage with channel_id field.
This is Phase 2 of conversation tabs (Phase 1 is one thread with inline events, which tend-conversation-core handles).

steps.title: Implement ProjectMessage interface with channel_id and metadata
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/types/message.ts. Define ProjectMessage interface: id, project_id, channel_id ('main' | 'agent-{agentId}'), role ('user' | 'assistant' | 'system'), content, metadata (attention_level, block_refs, step_refs, event_type), created_at. Export type.

steps.title: Create AgentTabBar above ConversationPane
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/conversation/AgentTabBar.tsx. Renders tabs horizontally above conversation. Main tab always present. Agent tabs spawn when forge creates tasks. Active tab highlighted. Reference planner-ui tab patterns if any exist.

steps.title: Create AgentTab component for agent message streams
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/conversation/AgentTab.tsx. Adapt planner-ui ChannelView pattern. Filter messages by channel_id. Show tool calls, reasoning trace, progress. Add completion indicator (green checkmark). Add blocked indicator (red dot). Auto-collapse after delay when completed.

steps.title: Wire tab filtering by channel_id
steps.description: In ConversationMessages: filter messages by active tab's channel_id. Main tab shows channel_id='main' (user/AI/system events). Agent tabs show channel_id='agent-{agentId}' (tool calls/reasoning). Update ConversationPane to manage active tab state.

steps.title: Implement tab lifecycle and interaction
steps.description: Wire tab spawning: on forge task creation, create new agent tab. Wire tab reopening: clicking system event with agent reference opens that agent's tab (or switches if already open). Persist tab state in ProjectContext. On navigation, restore tabs from active forge tasks.

architect.source_pattern: planner-ui ChannelView adapted to per-agent filtering

tab_types.main: user messages, AI messages, system events

interactions.navigation: state persists, restored from forge tasks
